title: Journal Topic Recurrence Tracker
dataSources: Mood entries (`mood:entry`), meditation sessions (`meditation:session`), journal entries (`journal:entry`), gratitude logs (`gratitude:log`).
app: Mood, mindfulness and journaling apps — Daylio / How We Feel mood exports, Headspace / Insight Timer meditation logs, journaling and gratitude entries — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=journal:entry topic=*
| top limit=10 topic
| rename count as entries, percent as share_pct
description: Surfaces the journal topics that keep coming back so repeated worries or priorities are easier to notice.
value: Recurring themes often reveal the real story of a month better than reading one entry at a time.
implementation: Tag journal entries with a topic or prompt category; review the most common themes over your chosen window.
visualization: Top-10 table of journal topics by entry count and share.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which journal themes keep coming back, so repeated worries or goals stand out clearly.
